label: Mediaflow
Video preview
Video quality *Resolution of the preview drawn above the music bar while a video plays in another tab. Higher costs more CPU.*
Frame rate *Choose 15 or 30 frames per second.*
Captions *Shown under the preview. Follow YouTube shows them only when they are on in the video.*
Captions while the preview is hidden *Keeps captions on screen after the preview's hide button is pressed.*
Grow on hover *Pointing at the preview enlarges it over the page, away from the sidebar, keeping its bottom edge in place. Its room above the music bar stays the resting size.*
Click the preview to go to its tab *Switches to the tab the video is playing in.*

Controls on the preview *Like Firefox's Picture-in-Picture window, shown while pointing at the preview: play and pause, skip back and forward, a timeline to drag, mute, open it in Picture-in-Picture, and hide the preview. Pausing from here keeps the preview up.*
Skip back and forward by
Make room above the preview *Off, the preview sits in front of the tabs. On, the tab list ends above it, so no tab is ever behind it.*
Music bar
Always show title and progress *Zen shows them only while you hover the player, floating them over the tabs. On, they are part of the player and the tab list makes room.*

Keep the player's size when pointed at *Keeps the toolbar height, control-row space and row padding unchanged on hover, including with Arc 2.0. Where title and progress show only on hover (Zen's own layout, without Arc 2.0 or the setting above) they still appear, without extra padding.*

Wait before expanding (ms) *Pointing at the music bar raises its title and progress rows, and pointing at the preview grows it. Both wait this long, so passing over them on the way somewhere else leaves them as they are.*
Hide the title row *Also hides the picture-in-picture and close buttons, which sit in that row.*
Hide the progress bar
Hide the playback buttons *With the title row and progress bar also hidden, the player is hidden entirely.*
Hide the floating music notes *The animated notes Zen draws above the player while music plays.*
*Colour and glass behind the player are in Glassflow, under Overlays or Blur and transparency.*
